audio.waveform.dynamic_range: 20*log10((95th percentile absolute amplitude+1e-12)/(10th percentile+1e-12)) per mono waveform; an amplitude-relative percentile range in decibels.
event.timing.event_rate: (event count-1)/(last-first time) per event sequence; returns zero with fewer than two events or nonpositive span. Lists are sorted; a bare 1D ndarray is not.
geometry.distances.euclidean: Euclidean distance of each point from the whole point set's centroid, in coordinate units; no reference-point parameter.
graph.cycles.cycle_count: Number of cycles in NetworkX's undirected cycle basis, rather than a count of every simple cycle.
image.color.red_mean: NaN-ignoring spatial mean of channel 0 per image; grayscale input uses its intensity mean, channels are not rescaled.
information.entropy.shannon: Shannon entropy in nats per probability/count row after clipping negatives to zero and sum normalization; all-zero rows yield zero.
manifold.dimension.intrinsic_dimension: Median of the local neighbor-distance dimension estimates, repeated for every point; forwards k=10 to the local estimator.
matrix.algebra.sparsity: Fraction of matrix entries close to zero under NumPy isclose defaults, rather than the fraction exactly equal to zero.
multimodal.fusion.late_fusion: Weighted sum of two supplied embedding rows truncated to their common width; weights default to (0.5,0.5), with no weight normalization.
pointcloud.geometry.bbox_volume: Product of coordinate-wise ranges in each cloud: axis-aligned bounding-box hypervolume, with zero for any zero-span axis.
sequence.entropy.shannon: Shannon entropy in nats of empirical token counts per sequence; string tokens are characters, and empty input has entropy zero.
signal.frequency.psd: First n_bins=16 available squared centered real-FFT magnitudes per row, DC forced zero; unnormalized power bins, not Welch density.
spatial.hotspots.getis_ord: Mean supplied value over each point's symmetric binary k=8 neighbor set; a local neighbor average, not a standardized Getis-Ord significance score.
tabular.interactions.logical: AND, OR and XOR after testing each numeric-coerced value !=0; three float flags per row, NaN compares unequal to zero and is treated as true.
text.lexical.word_count: Count of lowercase Unicode regex word tokens per document; tokenizer retains word characters, apostrophes and hyphens within word boundaries.
timeseries.recurrence.recurrence_rate: Fraction of true entries in the recurrence matrix after diagonal removal, denominator includes all matrix cells; fixed 2D delay-1 embedding, finite rows, at most 600 points, 10th-percentile positive-distance threshold.
topology.persistence.image: Histogram of positive H0 MST death lengths, weighted by those same lengths, with bins=16 spanning zero to maximum death; at most 400 points, not a Gaussian persistence image.
video.motion.frame_difference_energy: Mean squared grayscale difference between adjacent frames over all pixels and frame pairs; one value per clip, not divided by elapsed time.
